small_visual_text.where: Figure axes and legends are difficult to read at a standard viewing distance, which may hinder comprehension of the visual data.

missing_sections.where: Missing Abstract and Introduction sections, which may affect the initial understanding of the research.

layout.reason: The layout is balanced and uses the canvas efficiently, but missing Abstract and Introduction sections reduce structural completeness.

readability.reason: Text is generally readable, but figure axes and legends are too small to be legible at a standard viewing distance.

fidelity.reason: The poster emphasizes the main findings accurately, with figures and captions supporting the results effectively.

holistic.reason: The poster is a usable draft with clear emphasis on the main findings, but missing sections and small figure text hinder communication and require improvement.
